info.name: CAM Platform — External Data Source APIs
info.description:
Mock server for all external data sources consumed by the CAM Intelligence Platform.

**Data Sources Covered:**
- 🏛️ MCA (Ministry of Corporate Affairs) — Company Master, Directors, Charges
- 📊 CIBIL Commercial Bureau — Credit Report
- 🧾 GSTN — GST Registration & Turnover
- ⭐ Credit Rating (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE)
- 📰 Market Intelligence & News Sentiment
- 📈 BSE/NSE Exchange Filings
- 📁 Document Management Store

**Coverage:** 16 companies (4 synthetic + 12 real-inspired)

**How to use:**
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Create a Mock Server from this collection
3. Copy the Mock Server URL
4. Set `CAM_MOCK_URL` environment variable to the URL
5. The CAM app will call the mock server for all external data

**To modify data:** Open any request → Examples tab → Edit the response JSON → Save.
The mock server reflects changes immediately.

item.name: 🚀 RM Onboarding Workflow
item.description:
Complete RM workflow:
1. RM enters CIN → System auto-fetches all public data (MCA, Bureau, GST, Rating, News)
2. System shows RM what data was found and what's missing
3. RM uploads missing documents (audited financials, provisionals, board resolution)
4. System runs OCR on uploaded PDFs → extracts financial data
5. Pipeline runs with complete data → generates CAM

The CIN-Lookup endpoint triggers all external API calls and returns a summary.
